entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is a petition seeking quashing of the FIR No. 189/2019 dated 20.05.2019 registered at PS Karawal Nagar under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. The quashing of the FIR is based on a settlement dated 01.02.2020 arrived at before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi, wherein a total sum of Rs. 7.15 lakhs was to be paid to the respondent No.2 by the petitioner.

entities.text: Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
A sum of Rs. 5 lakhs has already been paid to the respondent No.2 and the balance sum of Rs. 2.15 lakhs is being paid today in Court vide DD No.
802067 dated 30.05.2023 drawn on Bank of Baroda.
3. The petitioner is present in Court and has been identified by Mr. Deepak Kumar, learned counsel.

sentences.text: The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by SI Sukram Pal, PS Karawal Nagar.
5. The parties state that they have arrived at the above said settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
6. The respondent No.2 states that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.

7. There is one minor child who is in the care and custody of the respondent No.2.
8.

As per the judgment of the Honble Supreme Court in 'Ganesh vs. Sudhirkumar Srivastava'
[(2020) 20 SCC 787], the settlement and this order shall not affect the rights of the minor child in claiming the rights of maintenance, inheritance, education, marriage etc. against either of the parties.

9. With these directions, the FIR No. 189/2019 dated 20.05.2019 registered at PS Karawal Nagar under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
10. The petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
JASMEET SINGH, J MAY 31, 2023 /
